//: Emit-only config. tsconfig.json (allowJs, strict, noEmit) stays the typecheck source of truth. Here allowJs is off so tsc emits only .ts files: the JS domains import repo-root lib/*.js, which sits outside rootDir and cannot be emitted (TS5055). JS sources (domains/, auth.js, providers.js) are copied to dist by scripts/copy-dist-assets.mjs. noImplicitAny is off only to silence TS7016 for the JS imports; emitted JS is type-independent and identical either way.
